diagnosis: get_vehicle_live_gps resolves VehicleAsset through an injected VehicleLocatorService class dependency. The lookup queries the vehicle strictly by VIN without verifying that the vehicle belongs to the authenticated carrier's logistics fleet, allowing third-party freight operators to monitor real-time GPS locations, route coordinates, and speeds of high-value cargo trucks owned by competitors.
